notes.title: 1.018 Update
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
In this update, we are leaving early access. This does not mean that the work on the game is stopped. I'll still be glad to know your suggestions and correct the problems that have arisen.
Thank you for supporting the game at an early stage of its development!

Updated:
- Added a short guide to the game.
-added statistics button.
-added button "titles".
-updated match screen.
-Ambient Occolusion.
-Auto Expose.
-Bloom.
-Chromatic Abberation.
-Color Grading.
-Grain.
-Screen Space Reflections.
-Vignette.

notes.title: 1.017Beta Update and some news...
notes.content:
Hi players!
I am glad to welcome you in the New Year!
I wish you happiness and good luck in the next year!

In this update, statistics and achievements were added. Statistics are not yet available for review, but you can get achievements already today! :)
Leave your suggestions about new achievements on the forum, maybe I'll add something to the game.

And now for the news. The activity of the community is very small, there are practically no proposals for improving the gameplay and also complaints about the problems in the game. And this means that the period of early access may soon come to an end. If the community does not become more active in expressing its opinion, I will add more statistics, introduce small cosmetic additions and the game will enter the release stage. And this means more online rivals for you, players :) So the news can be considered joyful! :)

notes.title: 1.016Beta update
notes.content:
Hi guys,
I am glad to welcome you today with a new update!
I hope you enjoy the possibility of changing the camera as well as a new skin for 3d mode.
I will be happy with your feedback and comments!
Added:
  - possibility of changing the camera
  - new skin for 3d mode
  - new menu items for selecting skins
  - skybox
Fixed:
  - the position of all elements in the 3-dimensional space, in connection with the addition of the possibility of changing the camera.
  - as usual, some improvement in the network architecture.

notes.title: 1.012Beta update
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31003190/61745e0b7db6c95aaed8b0b3436c57be2d047084.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31003190/0d65bcd93758433dce3c66b3857a5a65c43025a1.jpg[/img][/url]
Hi players!)
I am glad to welcome you with the new update. I'm sure you'll like it)
The game came out very recently and finding a player for the match can be quite difficult now. I hope that the surprise that I have prepared will allow you to get a new experience from the game!
Now you can not only play yourself or with friends, but also play with the CPU or with friends and the CPU together!
Just specify how many CPUs you want when you create the game in the corresponding field.

As with the introduction of everything new, there may be minor complications. There is a small bug in which one or two CPUs (depending on the total number of players in the match) cross the zero mark of coordinates slightly go crazy and start driving around the whole field) Do not worry, this is exactly what I am working on, this the bug will be fixed.

I will be happy with your feedback and links to new bugs!

P.S. Do not forget to use the "space" if you play on the keyboard or a button on the joystick to install two protective blocks per match, I think this will help you win)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31003190/61745e0b7db6c95aaed8b0b3436c57be2d047084.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Few additions to 3d mode
notes.content:

 - color change on balls.
Added:

 - 3D object for Catcher

notes.title: HotFix and litlle more...
notes.content:
Hello dear players,
Today, due to an unforeseen little problem, hotfix was released. It also contains small changes and developments for the future of the concept.

Fixed:
  - Bug board of the final results, in which it was shown immediately at the beginning of the match.

Added by:
   - Concept 3D mode, in which everything will be complemented by animated 3D textures.
   - Backlighting and checking for blank fields before creating a room.
